$comment: evo-1 security mitigation. PreToolUse write-confinement hook for the discovery/evaluation agents (the `claude -p` runs driven by HEARTBEAT-DAILY.md / EVALUATE-PENDING.md). These agents hold Write + WebFetch and read attacker-controllable internet content; a prompt-injection payload could steer a write to a sensitive path. The discovery/eval agents are NOT defined as agent-frontmatter files -- they are `claude -p` invocations that cd into this project, so the hook is wired here at the project level rather than in agent frontmatter. See .claude/hooks/block-sensitive-writes.sh and SECURITY.md (interim mitigation; full Write-stripping wrapper deferred). Command is double-quoted (claude.write_hook_space_path_02 / claude.write_hook_space_path_failopen_02): unquoted, a checkout path containing a space is word-split before the hook script starts, its EXIT trap never runs, and Claude Code treats the non-2 launch failure as non-blocking -- i.e. every write proceeds unchecked. A second PreToolUse hook (Read|Glob|Grep) guards the read side of the same threat model (claude.read_web_exfil_01): discovery/evaluation agents hold Read+Glob+Grep in the same session as WebFetch/WebSearch with no prior technical confinement on what local content could enter the model context or a network-tool argument. See .claude/hooks/block-sensitive-reads.sh.
